name: PSINet Australia
summary: PSINet Inc's Australian operation (rebrand of Zircon/Internet Plus, from ~2000; IP network carrier, managed hosting, ~650 corporate/SME clients); PSINet Inc filed Chapter 11 31 May 2001; AU assets sold to National Telecoms Group (2002) (ZIRCON SYSTEMS PTY LIMITED (FORMERLY PSINET AUSTRALIA PTY LTD), ACN 003 233 421).

events.details: PSINet acquired Zircon; rebranded as PSINet Australia ~2000. NOTE: unrelated to 'PSInet' of Perth, a local computer support firm founded Jan 1992 by Mark Siena that became the 5th Perth ISP and sold its ISP operations to iiNet c.1999.
AU assets sold to National Telecoms Group (<$1M, reported 5 Jun 2002).
